# G0 evidence - 2026-10-18

Baseline: c829a33d07de9a8fa376b407658875d22abd246e (clean package checkout).
SDK: Flutter 3.47.2, Dart 3.13.2, macOS arm64. Package build pins .fvmrc.
A temporary pure-Dart `@JSExport` / `createJSInteropWrapper` probe compiled
with `fvm dart compile js -O2` in 0.27 s to 64,753 bytes. A 37-degree matrix
and glyph path display list compared exactly between Dart VM and an isolated
headless browser loading file:// (kernel call cold sample 1.1 ms). This small
probe established export feasibility, not final package parity/performance.
Final shared-core browser parity/hit tests supersede this probe in the report.

A minimal Flutter Material app built with `--no-web-resources-cdn`.
Default file:// base resolved the bootstrap at file:///flutter_bootstrap.js.
After correcting base to ./, file:// still failed: Flutter view absent,
loader errors and ServiceWorker SecurityError for origin null.
The identical artifact at http://127.0.0.1:18762 loaded a flutter-view and
made zero non-loopback resource requests. Browser and owned server stopped.
Therefore the Flutter kit uses an explicit package-owned loopback launcher;
the JS consumer and static result report can use file://. No LAN bind.

Font proof uses licensed local Roboto and Roboto Slab fixtures, offline
fontTools 4.67.0 outline extraction, font SHA256/source/license metadata,
and actual cubic/quadratic paths shared by both renderers. This is an example
provider fixture, not a production catalog. Runtime makes no font downloads.

Final browser evidence exposed an SDK-specific image API limit: in Flutter
3.47.2 web, `ImageDescriptor.encoded(...).width/height` throws an unsupported
operation. The demo therefore reads bounded PNG/JPEG/WebP encoded dimensions
before allocating a raster codec, applies the 40-million-pixel/8-MiB limits,
then uses `instantiateImageCodec` and checks the decoded dimensions against the
saved metadata. Native buffers and descriptors are no longer assumed portable.
The pure header reader has 12 truncation/framing/format/dimension tests. It does
not replace image decoding or provide an alternate scene/geometry engine.
